AceOfCups.name: Ace of Cups
AceOfCups.meaning: The Ace of Cups brings emotional abundance, new love, compassion and inner joy. It marks the beginning of deep emotional fulfilment or a new relationship.
AceOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to suppressed emotions, blocked creativity, unrequited love or emotional overwhelm. You may feel emotionally empty or flooded.

AceOfPentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles
AceOfPentacles.meaning: A new beginning in finances, career or the physical world. An opportunity for stability, prosperity and a material gift is emerging.
AceOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can indicate missed opportunities, financial instability, poor investments or a lack of planning. The gift is delayed or lost.

AceOfSwords.name: Ace of Swords
AceOfSwords.meaning: A breakthrough, mental clarity, intellectual power and a new idea. You can cut through confusion and see the truth.
AceOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can indicate confusion, mental chaos, misuse of intellect or cruelty. The truth is clouded, or your approach is too harsh.

AceOfWands.name: Ace of Wands
AceOfWands.meaning: A fresh start filled with inspiration, growth and a flash of creativity. Take the first step towards a new idea, project or venture.
AceOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to procrastination, lack of direction, blocked creativity or missed opportunities. Your energy may be low or scattered.

Death.name: Death
Death.meaning: Death symbolises transformation, endings and new beginnings. One phase is ending so another can begin; embrace change and release the past.
Death.meaning_reversed: Reversed, Death points to resistance to change, stagnation, fear of the unknown or clinging to an unhealthy situation.

EightOfCups.name: Eight of Cups
EightOfCups.meaning: Walking away from something that no longer fulfils you. You leave the familiar in search of deeper emotional or spiritual truth.
EightOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to fear of leaving, returning to the past, hesitation or clinging to an unfulfilling situation.

EightOfPentacles.name: Eight of Pentacles
EightOfPentacles.meaning: Dedication, craftsmanship, training and attention to detail. Focus on your skills and strive to do your work well.
EightOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to perfectionism, lack of ambition, poor workmanship or excessive focus on work. You may be too critical or unwilling to try.

EightOfSwords.name: Eight of Swords
EightOfSwords.meaning: Feeling trapped by restrictions, many of which are self-imposed. The swords are not binding you; you can remove the blindfold yourself.
EightOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to breaking free of limitations, liberation and finally seeing a way out. You are ready to remove the blindfold.

EightOfWands.name: Eight of Wands
EightOfWands.meaning: Speed, action, movement and swift news. Things are moving quickly; prepare for rapid changes and developments.
EightOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to delays, waiting, frustration or missed opportunities. Energy is blocked or becoming chaotic.

FiveOfCups.name: Five of Cups
FiveOfCups.meaning: Loss, grief and regret, as well as difficulty seeing the blessings that remain. Remember to look at the two cups still standing.
FiveOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to releasing grief, accepting loss, forgiveness and the first steps towards healing. You are beginning to see the positive.

FiveOfPentacles.name: Five of Pentacles
FiveOfPentacles.meaning: Loss, poverty, insecurity and feeling left out. Ask for help: support is available, even if you cannot see it yet.
FiveOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to recovery, accepting help, the end of hardship or finding work or a home again. A difficult period is passing.

FiveOfSwords.name: Five of Swords
FiveOfSwords.meaning: Conflict, loss, winning at another's expense or bullying. A victory may not be worth its price; set pride aside and seek peace.
FiveOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to an uneasy truce, remorse, a desire for peace or refusing to learn from defeat. The cost of conflict is too high.

FiveOfWands.name: Five of Wands
FiveOfWands.meaning: Competition, disagreements and minor conflicts. Energy is high but disorganised; face challenges while remaining thoughtful.
FiveOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to avoiding conflict, ignoring disagreements or ending a struggle, sometimes by giving in. The tension may go underground.

FourOfCups.name: Four of Cups
FourOfCups.meaning: Apathy, boredom, dissatisfaction and overlooking opportunities. You may be so focused on what is missing that you fail to see what is offered.
FourOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to a new perspective, accepting an offer, letting go of apathy or a sudden realisation. You are ready to move on.

FourOfPentacles.name: Four of Pentacles
FourOfPentacles.meaning: Possessiveness, control, holding on to resources and fear of change. Release the need for control to find genuine stability.
FourOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to letting go of control, sharing resources and generosity, or sometimes wastefulness. You may be less afraid to share.

FourOfSwords.name: Four of Swords
FourOfSwords.meaning: Rest, recovery, meditation and the need to withdraw. You need a break after stress; give yourself time to heal.
FourOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to restlessness, burnout, insufficient recovery or leaving your refuge too soon. You may be forcing yourself into action.

FourOfWands.name: Four of Wands
FourOfWands.meaning: Celebration, harmony, security and coming home. A card of stability, success and joyful milestones, such as a wedding or housewarming.
FourOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to disharmony, insecurity at home, an unstable foundation or a lack of celebration. Your safe haven feels unsettled.

Judgement.name: Judgement
Judgement.meaning: Rebirth, renewal and a call to action. Reflect, forgive, make important decisions, learn from the past and embrace a new chapter.
Judgement.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to self-criticism, self-doubt, postponing a decision or refusing to learn from past mistakes. Forgive yourself and move forward.

Justice.name: Justice
Justice.meaning: Honesty, balance and truth. Act with integrity, weigh your options carefully and accept the consequences of your decisions.
Justice.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to injustice, dishonesty, legal trouble or avoiding responsibility. Reconsider your actions and be truthful.

KingOfCups.name: King of Cups
KingOfCups.meaning: Emotional balance, self-control and diplomacy. Lead others with wisdom and keep your composure while managing your feelings.
KingOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to mood swings, emotional imbalance, suppressed feelings or manipulation. Your emotions may be turbulent.

KingOfPentacles.name: King of Pentacles
KingOfPentacles.meaning: Prosperity, financial security, enterprise and reliability. A successful, stable leader knows how to manage resources.
KingOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to corruption, gambling, greed or abuse of power. Your financial empire may be built on shaky ground.

KingOfSwords.name: King of Swords
KingOfSwords.meaning: Intellectual authority, clarity and truth. Use logic to lead and seek an objective understanding of the facts.
KingOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to tyranny, misuse of intellect, cynicism or unethical behaviour. Your reasoning may be biased or domineering.

KingOfWands.name: King of Wands
KingOfWands.meaning: Leadership, vision, enterprise and authority. Take charge and inspire others with your passion and clear vision of the future.
KingOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to tyranny, impulsiveness, excessive demands or poor leadership. You may be misusing your power.

KnightOfCups.name: Knight of Cups
KnightOfCups.meaning: A charming messenger bringing an invitation or emotional offer. Romance, idealism and following your heart are central themes.
KnightOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to a lack of romance, disappointment, a false offer or deception. The ideal may be an illusion.

KnightOfPentacles.name: Knight of Pentacles
KnightOfPentacles.meaning: Reliable, hardworking and patient. The steadiest, though slowest, of the Knights: make steady progress with dedication.
KnightOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to laziness, stagnation, missed opportunities through slowness or boredom. You may lack the drive to move forward.

KnightOfSwords.name: Knight of Swords
KnightOfSwords.meaning: Courageous, ambitious and charging ahead. This card represents swift action, but can warn against recklessness. Think before you act or speak.
KnightOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to recklessness, aggression, moving too fast or a sudden slowdown. Your actions may be poorly considered.

KnightOfWands.name: Knight of Wands
KnightOfWands.meaning: Action, adventure and restless energy. Move forward quickly and passionately, but pay attention to where you are heading.
KnightOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to recklessness, delays, frustration or an inability to finish a plan. You may be rushing without direction.

NineOfCups.name: Nine of Cups
NineOfCups.meaning: Wish fulfilment, contentment and emotional satisfaction. Known as the wish card, it suggests satisfaction with your emotional life.
NineOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to smugness, dissatisfaction, not getting what you want or excess. Your wish has not yet been fulfilled.

NineOfPentacles.name: Nine of Pentacles
NineOfPentacles.meaning: Independence, refinement, self-sufficiency and material comfort. You created your own success; take time to enjoy it.
NineOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to dependence, financial setbacks, difficulty enjoying success or excessive focus on appearances. You may not be truly independent.

NineOfSwords.name: Nine of Swords
NineOfSwords.meaning: Anxiety, worry, nightmares and sleeplessness. Mental anguish can feel worse than reality; seek support and calm your mind.
NineOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to releasing fear, easing worries, seeking help or a deep secret. You are beginning to recover.

NineOfWands.name: Nine of Wands
NineOfWands.meaning: Resilience, determination and being close to the finish line. You are tired but determined; that final effort can carry you through.
NineOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to paranoia, fear, lack of stamina or giving up at the last moment. You may be afraid to take the final step.

PageOfCups.name: Page of Cups
PageOfCups.meaning: A messenger of news, a fresh start or an emotional offer. It represents sensitivity, creativity and the emergence of new feelings.
PageOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to bad news, creative blocks, insecurity or emotional immaturity. The offer may be false or withdrawn.

PageOfPentacles.name: Page of Pentacles
PageOfPentacles.meaning: A student, financial news or an opportunity to begin a practical project. Be thorough, curious and willing to learn.
PageOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to bad financial news, laziness, lack of focus at school or work, or unrealistic financial plans. You may be unprepared.

PageOfSwords.name: Page of Swords
PageOfSwords.meaning: Alert, curious and intellectually active. A messenger of news or the beginning of a mental challenge; be careful with your words.
PageOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to gossip, lack of focus, misuse of words or poor planning. You may be speaking too much or too carelessly.

PageOfWands.name: Page of Wands
PageOfWands.meaning: Excitement, inspiration and the beginning of a new adventure. A message about a creative project or journey invites you to embrace the unknown.
PageOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to bad news, creative blocks, lack of focus or delays in an important message. The excitement may be short-lived.

QueenOfCups.name: Queen of Cups
QueenOfCups.meaning: Compassion, intuition and emotional stability. This nurturing figure leads with the heart; listen to your intuition and show empathy.
QueenOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to emotional dependence, insecurity, volatility or emotional manipulation. Your intuition may be clouded.

QueenOfPentacles.name: Queen of Pentacles
QueenOfPentacles.meaning: Nurturing, practical abundance and creating a comfortable home. Generous, grounded and capable of caring for others.
QueenOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to financial dependence, possessiveness, neglecting yourself or a chaotic home. Your foundations may feel insecure.

QueenOfSwords.name: Queen of Swords
QueenOfSwords.meaning: Independence, sharp wit and impartiality. Communicate with logic and clarity, though you may sometimes seem cold.
QueenOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to emotional distance, cruelty, bias or using logic to hurt others. You may be too sharp or detached.

QueenOfWands.name: Queen of Wands
QueenOfWands.meaning: Courage, independence and social confidence. An energetic, self-assured leader uses charisma to bring a vision to life.
QueenOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to dominance, jealousy, selfishness or low self-confidence. Your energy may be unfocused or overwhelming.

SevenOfCups.name: Seven of Cups
SevenOfCups.meaning: Imagination, choices and overwhelming possibilities. You have many dreams but lack focus; choose one cup and direct your energy towards it.
SevenOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to confusion, unclear choices or a lack of direction. You may have too many options or none that feel clear.

SevenOfPentacles.name: Seven of Pentacles
SevenOfPentacles.meaning: Patience, waiting for results and evaluating an investment. You are nearly there, but it is not yet time to harvest.
SevenOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to impatience, uncertainty about results, a poor investment or abandoning a project too soon. Give it time.

SevenOfSwords.name: Seven of Swords
SevenOfSwords.meaning: Secrecy, deception, trying to get away with something or taking a shortcut. Be honest with yourself and others.
SevenOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to admitting deception, revealing a secret or accepting the consequences of dishonesty. Learn from your mistakes.

SevenOfWands.name: Seven of Wands
SevenOfWands.meaning: Defence, courage and standing your ground. You are being challenged, but you hold a strong position. Stand up for yourself.
SevenOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to giving up, feeling overwhelmed, cowardice or avoiding responsibility. Your position may have become uncertain.

SixOfCups.name: Six of Cups
SixOfCups.meaning: Nostalgia, memories of the past, childhood and innocence. Someone from your past may return, or you may reconnect with your inner child.
SixOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to living in the past, unhealthy attachment to memories or the need to focus on the future. The past is holding you back.

SixOfPentacles.name: Six of Pentacles
SixOfPentacles.meaning: Give and take, sharing, charity and financial balance. Be gracious both as a giver and as a receiver.
SixOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to an imbalance in giving and receiving, selfishness, debt or broken promises. Resources are being distributed unfairly.

SixOfSwords.name: Six of Swords
SixOfSwords.meaning: Transition, moving away from trouble, travel and heading towards better times. You are leaving a difficult past behind.
SixOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to stagnation, returning to the past or being unable to escape problems. You may struggle to make the crossing.

SixOfWands.name: Six of Wands
SixOfWands.meaning: Victory, public recognition, success and confidence. You have overcome a challenge and are being recognised; enjoy the moment.
SixOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to delayed success, false hope, lost confidence or not receiving the recognition you expected. The victory may feel hollow.

Strength.name: Strength
Strength.meaning: Courage, inner strength and resilience. Meet challenges with patience and compassion, master your impulses and face your fears gracefully.
Strength.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to weakness, insecurity, fear or a lack of self-control. You need to rediscover your inner courage.

Temperance.name: Temperance
Temperance.meaning: Balance, harmony and moderation. Be patient, find compromise and bring different parts of your life together to create peace.
Temperance.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to imbalance, excess, discord or going too far in one direction. Find a middle ground.

TenOfCups.name: Ten of Cups
TenOfCups.meaning: Lasting harmony, emotional fulfilment and family happiness. It represents a happily-ever-after and deep emotional peace.
TenOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to broken family harmony, arguments, conflict at home or chasing an illusion of perfect happiness. Peace has been disrupted.

TenOfPentacles.name: Ten of Pentacles
TenOfPentacles.meaning: Lasting wealth, financial security and inheritance. Family, community and a stable foundation for the future are central themes.
TenOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to financial insecurity, family disputes, breaking with tradition or an unstable future. Your sense of security may be fading.

TenOfSwords.name: Ten of Swords
TenOfSwords.meaning: A painful ending, crisis or rock bottom, but also the promise of a new beginning. The worst is over and recovery can begin.
TenOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to avoiding an ending, postponing a crisis or recovering from a low point. You may fear the worst is still to come.

TenOfWands.name: Ten of Wands
TenOfWands.meaning: Heavy burdens, responsibility and the need to lighten your load. You have taken on too much; delegate tasks or set boundaries.
TenOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to releasing burdens, exhaustion or struggling to carry responsibility. You may be tired of carrying everything.

TheChariot.name: The Chariot
TheChariot.meaning: Willpower, determination and control. Achieve success through focused effort, perseverance and confidence in overcoming obstacles.
TheChariot.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to lack of control or direction, defeat or ambitions going off course. Regain the reins or reconsider your goals.

TheDevil.name: The Devil
TheDevil.meaning: Temptation, materialism and bondage. Face negative patterns, addictions and your shadow self to free yourself from limiting beliefs.
TheDevil.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to breaking chains, escaping addiction or freeing yourself from limiting beliefs. You are beginning to master your shadow side.

TheEmperor.name: The Emperor
TheEmperor.meaning: Authority, structure and control. Take charge, set clear boundaries and build a solid foundation for your goals.
TheEmperor.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to dominance, rigidity, abuse of power or lack of structure. Loosen your grip or create more discipline.

TheEmpress.name: The Empress
TheEmpress.meaning: Abundance, fertility and nurturing. Connect with creativity, sensuality and the beauty of nature; cultivate growth in your life.
TheEmpress.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to insecurity, smothering, blocked creativity or neglecting self-care. Material concerns may also arise.

TheFool.name: The Fool
TheFool.meaning: New beginnings, spontaneity and taking a leap of faith. Embrace adventure and uncertainty with an open mind and trust your instincts.
TheFool.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to recklessness, thoughtless action, lack of planning or avoiding responsibility. Consider the situation before you leap.

TheHangedMan.name: The Hanged Man
TheHangedMan.meaning: Surrender, sacrifice and a change of perspective. Let go of control, pause and remain open to new insights.
TheHangedMan.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to unwillingness to make sacrifices, stagnant energy, delayed decisions or refusing a necessary pause.

TheHermit.name: The Hermit
TheHermit.meaning: Introspection, solitude and self-discovery. Withdraw from the noise of the world to seek inner wisdom and spiritual growth.
TheHermit.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to excessive isolation, loneliness, withdrawing from others or refusing to ask for help. Find balance between solitude and connection.

TheHierophant.name: The Hierophant
TheHierophant.meaning: Tradition, conformity and spiritual guidance. Seek wisdom from established sources and consider conventional paths and institutions.
TheHierophant.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to nonconformity, challenging tradition or choosing personal beliefs over rules. Find your own truth.

TheHighPriestess.name: The High Priestess
TheHighPriestess.meaning: Intuition, mystery and hidden knowledge. Trust your inner wisdom and pay attention to your dreams and instincts.
TheHighPriestess.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to ignoring intuition, suppressed feelings, superficiality or secrets needing to be revealed. Your mind may be overriding inner knowledge.

TheLovers.name: The Lovers
TheLovers.meaning: Love, partnerships and choices. This card represents unity, harmony and making conscious decisions aligned with your values and heart.
TheLovers.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to disharmony, poor choices, relationship problems or conflicting values. You may be struggling with an important decision.

TheMagician.name: The Magician
TheMagician.meaning: Power, skill and resourcefulness. Focus your intention and take action: you have the tools and talents needed to reach your goals.
TheMagician.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to manipulation, untapped potential, deception or lack of willpower. Examine your motives and regain your focus.

TheMoon.name: The Moon
TheMoon.meaning: Intuition, illusion and the subconscious. Explore hidden fears and uncertainty, face your inner world and trust your instincts.
TheMoon.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to confusion clearing, overcoming fear, subconscious material surfacing or secrets being revealed. Illusions are beginning to fade.

TheStar.name: The Star
TheStar.meaning: Hope, inspiration and renewal. Healing, faith and connection are at hand; remain optimistic and follow your dreams.
TheStar.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to despair, disappointment, lack of inspiration or discouragement. Reconnect with your inner hope.

TheSun.name: The Sun
TheSun.meaning: Joy, vitality and success. Embrace clarity and positivity, celebrate your achievements and let happiness shine.
TheSun.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to temporary sadness, lack of enthusiasm, uncertainty or postponed happiness. Look for clarity within.

TheTower.name: The Tower
TheTower.meaning: Sudden change, upheaval and revelation. Old structures may collapse so you can rebuild on a stronger foundation.
TheTower.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to fear of change, avoiding a necessary crisis or delaying the inevitable. Blocked energy needs to be released.

TheWorld.name: The World
TheWorld.meaning: Completion, fulfilment and unity. A cycle is successfully ending and goals have been reached; celebrate what you have achieved.
TheWorld.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to an unfinished cycle, delayed completion or seeking closure that has not yet arrived. One final effort may be needed.

ThreeOfCups.name: Three of Cups
ThreeOfCups.meaning: Celebration, friendship, community and successful collaboration. Enjoy the company of others and celebrate life's joys.
ThreeOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to excess, gossip, exclusion or too much partying. The joy may be superficial, or you may feel left out.

ThreeOfPentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
ThreeOfPentacles.meaning: Teamwork, recognition of skills and the first success of a project. Your talents are being seen and appreciated.
ThreeOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to poor teamwork, disagreement, low-quality work or lack of recognition. Collaboration is failing.

ThreeOfSwords.name: Three of Swords
ThreeOfSwords.meaning: Grief, disappointment, loss and heartbreak. A painful emotional wound is real, but healing can now begin.
ThreeOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to releasing grief, overcoming heartbreak or postponing necessary pain. You may be refusing to acknowledge your hurt.

ThreeOfWands.name: Three of Wands
ThreeOfWands.meaning: Progress, expansion and seeing the first results of your efforts. You are on the right path; trust your vision and be patient.
ThreeOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it can point to delays, obstacles to growth, trade setbacks or unfinished plans. Your expectations may have been premature.

TwoOfCups.name: Two of Cups
TwoOfCups.meaning: Unity, harmony, mutual attraction and forming romantic or business partnerships. Two people or forces meet in balance.
TwoOfCups.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to a breakup, disharmony in a relationship, separation or the end of a partnership. The connection is strained.

TwoOfPentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
TwoOfPentacles.meaning: Balancing multiple responsibilities, flexibility and setting priorities. You are juggling resources; keep your balance.
TwoOfPentacles.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to financial imbalance, overload, confusion or difficulty setting priorities. You may be dropping the ball.

TwoOfSwords.name: Two of Swords
TwoOfSwords.meaning: A stalemate, avoiding a decision and a blocked mind. Face the facts, remove the blindfold and make a choice.
TwoOfSwords.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to the end of a stalemate, facing the truth or delaying a decision. You may fear the consequences of taking action.

TwoOfWands.name: Two of Wands
TwoOfWands.meaning: Planning for the future and deciding on your next step. You have achieved something already; choose a direction and be bold.
TwoOfWands.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to fear of the unknown, postponed plans, poor preparation or retreating from an ambitious goal. Broaden your horizons.

WheelofFortune.name: Wheel of Fortune
WheelofFortune.meaning: Cycles, change and destiny. Life has its ups and downs; embrace change and trust that circumstances can turn in your favour.
WheelofFortune.meaning_reversed: Reversed, it points to bad luck, resistance to change, unexpected disruption or failing to learn from the past. You may feel powerless against fate.
